# fal_secret (Resource)

A secret that fal injects into apps as an environment variable, the equivalent of `fal secrets set`.

fal never returns a secret's value, so Terraform cannot detect a value changed outside Terraform. Set the value with either `value`, which Terraform keeps in its state, or `value_wo` (Terraform 1.11 or later), which it does not.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A secret in the main environment, exposed to every app.
resource "fal_secret" "hf_token" {
  name  = "HF_TOKEN"
  value = var.hf_token
}

# A secret kept out of Terraform's state (Terraform 1.11 or later), in its own
# environment, injected only into apps that list it in their secrets.
resource "fal_environment" "staging" {
  name        = "staging"
  description = "Apps under test"
}

resource "fal_secret" "api_key" {
  name             = "API_KEY"
  environment      = fal_environment.staging.name
  value_wo         = var.api_key
  value_wo_version = 1 # bump to set a new value_wo
  default_exposed  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The secret's name, which is also the name of the environment variable apps see.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `default_exposed` (Boolean) Whether fal injects the secret into every app (`true`), or only into apps that list it in their secrets (`false`). When not set, a new secret follows the account's default, and an existing one keeps its setting.
- `environment` (String) The fal environment the secret belongs to. Defaults to `main`.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret's value. Terraform stores it in its state; to keep it out, use `value_wo` instead.
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The secret's value, never stored in Terraform's state (write-only, Terraform 1.11 or later). Terraform cannot tell when it changes, so change `value_wo_version` to set a new value.
- `value_wo_version` (Number) Any number, required with `value_wo`; change it to set `value_wo` again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The secret's ID, `<environment>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <environment>/<name>, or <name> for the main environment. fal never returns a
# secret's value, so the next apply sets it from the configuration.
terraform import fal_secret.api_key staging/API_KEY
terraform import fal_secret.hf_token HF_TOKEN
```
